      "text": " BTC Finals Ruleset\n\nMatch Format, Setup \u0026 Lobby\nFormat: (Team) vs (Team)\nCondition to Win: Best of 15 (BO15) — First team to reach 8 points wins the match.\nPool Size: 24 Maps (6 NM, 4 HD, 4 HR, 4 DT, 4 FM, 1EZ, 1 TB).\nLobbies: Matches are refereed. The lobby host/referee must set the lobby to Team VS.\nThe referee invites the players through the APL-ref client for osu!lazer lobbies. \nThe Roll and Protect Phase: \nTeam captains must /roll in multiplayer lobby chat, when prompted.\nThe winner of the roll then gets to choose either: First Pick (First Protect) OR First Ban. The loser chooses from the remaining option.\nBefore any bans happen, each team can Protect 1 map. A protected map cannot be banned by either team, but it can be picked by anyone during the match.\nProtect Order: The team that picks first protects first. (Team 1 Protects ➔ Team 2 Protects). \nThe Ban Phase\nEach team can Ban up to 2 maps total (4 maps removed from the pool). You may not ban the Tiebreaker.\nBan Order: ABBA (Team 1 Bans, Team 2 Bans, Team 2 Bans, Team 1 Bans).\nThe Pick Phase\nTeams will alternate picks (ABAB).\nPlayers have 2-3 minutes for each decision and to select a map. If a team takes too long, the next decision and/or pick goes to the opposing team.\n FreeMod (FM) Rules: \nOn FreeMod picks, ALL players must take at least one mod, from either Hidden (HD), HardRock (HR), Easy (EZ) or any Difficulty increasing or Decreasing mod or any combination of the forementioned.\nYou may not modify any parameters within the mods themselves unless specified.\nOther mods outside the “Difficulty Reduction” and “Difficulty Increase” category are NOT allowed.\nIf any player on a team selects the Easy (EZ) mod, it acts as an attack on the opposing team. The opposing team is then forced to respond by either matching the Easy (EZ) mod OR playing with the HardRock (HR) mod. (sorry Kai, the FMs are too hard) \nDisconnects, technical difficulties \u0026 Tiebreakers\nIf a player disconnects in the first 1 minute of a map, the map can be aborted and replayed once. If they disconnect later again, their score counts from the moment they disconnect.\nIf the match score reaches 7-7, the teams will play the Tiebreaker (TB). The TB is played as FreeMod, but mods are strictly optional for all players.\nCustom rulesets:\nEZ score adjustment: from 0.5x to 0.9x (nerfed from 1.0x since maps are optimized for non-FC scores) \n\n\n",

      "text": "\n\n\n**Nah, BO15 is not a stretch at all!** In fact, for an osu! tournament, **BO15 (First to 8)** is the gold standard for a Finals or Grand Finals match. \n\nHere is a quick breakdown of why it works, and the few scenarios where you *might* want to drop it down to a BO13:\n\n### Why BO15 is perfect for Finals:\n* **It reduces RNG:** In shorter matches (like BO9), a player can win just by having a couple of lucky pop-offs or if the opponent has a brief cold streak. A BO15 is a true test of consistency and stamina.\n* **Standard Tourney Scaling:** Most standard osu! tournaments follow a progression like this: RO32/RO16 (BO9) ➔ Quarterfinals (BO11) ➔ Semifinals (BO13) ➔ **Finals (BO15)**. \n* **Pool Size Synergy:** You have a 24-map pool. In a full 15-map match with 4 bans, you are using exactly 19 out of your 24 maps. That leaves just enough unplayed maps so that teams actually have to strategize around what they pick and ban, without running out of options.\n\n### How long will it take?\n* Assuming an average map length of ~3 minutes.\n* Add in 2 minutes for every pick/ban phase.\n* Plus lobby loading, readying up, and potential 1-2 minute tactical breaks.\n* **Estimated Time:** A sweep (8-0) will take about 45–50 minutes. A full 7-7 Tiebreaker banger will take roughly **1.5 to 2 hours**. \n\n### When *would* BO15 be a stretch?\nIt might be too much **ONLY IF**:\n1. **Your maps are exceptionally long:** If your pool is full of 4 to 5+ minute endurance/stamina drainers, the players\u0027 hands will be dead by map 10. \n2. **The players are casuals:** If this is a more laid-back tournament and players aren\u0027t used to the mental fatigue of a 2-hour tournament match, they might start severely underperforming in the second half. \n\n**The Verdict:** Keep it at BO15 for that epic Finals tension!
